---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new feature or improvement for AOG
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Summary

A clear and concise description of the feature or improvement you are proposing.

## Motivation

Explain why this feature would be useful. What problem does it solve? Who would benefit?

## Proposed Solution

Describe the solution you have in mind. Include any relevant design or implementation details.

## Alternatives Considered

Describe any alternative solutions or features you have considered and why you prefer the proposed approach.

## Security Considerations

If this feature touches authentication, challenge verification, cryptographic operations, or replay protection, describe the potential security implications and any mitigations.

## Additional Context

Add any other context, examples, or references relevant to the feature request.
